text.description_html:
ADA Compliant Door Stop Arm Closer

PDQ 5101-BC-SCS door stop arm door closers are non-handed, and and can be mounted on the Push or Pull side of the door. Uses adjustable backcheck to slow the door opening and a rubber stop integrated into the closer arm to stop the door. When installing the closer, door stop can be set from 85 to 110 degrees of door opening angle.

The PDQ 5100 Series features full rack and pinion construction, heavy duty cast aluminum closer body, stamped flat style arm assembly with integrated rubber door stop and full architectural cover. Hydraulic control is achieved through separate hex-key non-critical sweep, latch and backcheck adjustments.

Package complete with fasteners for wood or metal doors and frames. Sex nuts and bolts are also furnished standard. ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 6 for use on interior doors requiring less than 5 lbs. of opening force and exterior doors requiring less than 8.5 lbs.

The 5100 series closer is listed by U.L./U.L.C. (UL US Listed 63Z0), complies with UL 10C and UBC 7-2 (1997) for positive pressure and conforms to the requirements of ANSI A156.4 Grade 1.

Also available: A full line of PDQ 5100 Door Closer Accessories.

Specifications and Features for the PDQ 5101-999817 Stop Arm Door Closer:

  • Door Opening Angle: Door Stop at 85 to 110 degrees
  • Adjustable Closing Speed
  • Adjustable Latching Speed
  • Adjustable Back Check
  • Cast Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Closer Body Length: 11-7/8"
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 11-1/8"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 258 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 58" interior / 54" exterior
  • Non-Handed
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • Spring Size: Adjustable 1-6
  • ADA Compliant
  • 25 Year Warranty
  • PDQ 5101 Stop Arm Installation Instructions (PDF)

Available in Aluminum or Dark Bronze finish.
